The left-wing Green Party in Germany's North Rhine-Westphalia, the country’s most populous state, wants the proportion of government ministry employees with migrant backgrounds to approach 32.5%, matching their share of the state's population.

Green Party Equality Minister Verena Schäffer has sent a survey to employees across state ministries asking whether they have an immigration background.

The policy is being pursued under the CDU-Green coalition led by Minister-President Hendrik Wüst and has drawn criticism from those arguing that government hiring should prioritize qualifications rather than demographic representation.

Yesterday, AIS data showed an Iranian tanker named ‘Khat Shekan’ heading through the Strait of Hormuz toward the Gulf of Oman. 

The signal has been spoofed. Satellite imagery did not corroborate the transit.

As of now, NO Iranian tanker has been seen trying to “break the blockade”
